headline: ASIAN CHIP ROUT INTO FOMC EVE: KOSPI -10% circuit-broken, Nikkei -4%; NDX -0.87% premkt; Iran pause holds but no US-Iran talks
client_frame: Overnight brought the sharpest single-session Asian tech selloff of the cycle — KOSPI down 10% (circuit-broken twice) on China chip breakthrough report + AI capex fears. Contagion to Nikkei (-4.3%), TAIEX (-4.7%). Chip stocks now in confirmed bear market: PHLX SEMI -21% from Jun ATH; SK Hynix/Samsung down 50%. NQ -0.87% premkt; ES -0.05%; YM +0.44% (rotation continues to defensives). Iran pause holds 3rd day but Iran FM denies negotiations exist — Trump claims disputed. Setup into FOMC Wed: chip capex fears at their worst moment, MSFT/META Wed AC will be the referendum on 2026 AI spend. Hedges essential through Wed 2pm; if MSFT/META guide capex flat/down, cascade risk is real.
